title: Integrate layered OBJ resources and verify managed initializers
changes: Publish E130 layered OBJ source with authenticated extraction, frontend persistence, typed runtime attachment and resource counters.
Extend dataset budget test calls for the new resource.
validation: The Windows GNU focused test build passed; the EUR Wine integration test checks 101 resources and 102 files, all 100 E129 resources unchanged, create/reuse/repair, all 633 poisoned spans (20,474 bytes), 16 original initializer full-state interpreter pairs and transactional coherent-tamper rejection. Protected inputs passed and scratch was removed: target/validation/units/e130-layered-obj-managed-build-final-n53v96ij/ and e130-layered-obj-managed-wine-sgpd5u9k/.

An earlier production build passed; its file guard rejected the result after a test-only source edit. An initial Wine launch could not open the host runtime lock from the sandbox; its own prefix lease was released only after host-visible ownership checks. Failed diagnostics remain retained. Two intermediate test builds failed on missing size arguments and a correction typo.

The production Windows CLI creates, reuses and verifies E130 under Wine; all 100 previous resources match, and reuse leaves hashes and timestamps unchanged. Guarded evidence: target/validation/units/e130-layered-obj-cli-build-final-l8obzzjw/ and e130-layered-obj-cli-current-rbr9ukkp/. The current generation is retained for pending regression filters.
limitations: The initializer translated-native cases were subsequently verified; the full draw path, remaining lifecycle scenarios, affected regressions and ordinary gameplay remain unverified. Linux, USA and native Windows are separate.
